attempts.feedback: якщо чесно я нікого не впізнав
diagnosis: The generator encoded category-level masses instead of the specific source construction.
Distinctive LEGO assemblies were reduced to generic rectangles, circles and wedges.
The test therefore measured recognition of abstract vehicle classes rather than recognition of roster assets.
attempts.consequence: Reject every V1 sheet. Do not continue to the 44- or 72-cell V1 review and do not count the V1 confusion audit as game-director evidence.
Approve the source-derived silhouette method for expansion to a new complete 66-asset corpus. This does not accept the complete roster or close T082.

activePilot.rule: The source-derived method may now expand to a second complete-roster corpus. T082 still requires the complete 24/44/72-cell blind review and explicit game-director corpus acceptance.
